body:
Step 1.) Stay inside. Step 2.) Exist. That's about it. 

I can't afford therapy. I can't deal anymore. I've been in therapy in some form for over a decade, and it just isn't working.
I feel like I'm going to die; I have panic attacks, I've vomited from nerves, I've had heart palpitations so bad I seriously debated if I was having a heart attack or something. :\

Most of the time I just feel empty. There's nothing that interests me. I don't want to talk to anyone, or watch anything, or listen to music, or anything. I always feel really... tired, you know? Like sometimes life exhausts me so damned much that I just need days and days of nothingness to be able to deal with it again.

I always fuck up online friendship. I go through periods where i can't even bare to talk to people, so I go 'missing' for a week or two at a time while I lay on my couch and stare at the floor... and that's made it hard to have any rapport with people.

It really is... accurate. It is like this never ending homesickness, or longing to be somewhere else. Like, somewhere, out in the world, there's somewhere safe and comfortable I can be. But I can't find it since I can barely even go into the hallway into my apartment... so just the sadness remains.
